card.name: Linking words in drug label cross-references
card.fires_on: Small linking marks in drug label text just before a key term: the colon after the heading DRUG ABUSE AND DEPENDENCE, "of" after "class effect", and "an" or "a" before a drug-class or drug name.

modes.label: Colon in section cross-reference
modes.description: The colon after the heading DRUG ABUSE AND DEPENDENCE in a "see" reference, before the subsection name Dependence.
modes.example: (see DRUG ABUSE AND DEPENDENCE<<:>> Dependence ). Protracted Withdrawal Syndrome

modes.label: Word before a drug class
modes.description: "of" after "class effect", or "an" or "a" right before a drug or enzyme-inhibitor name.
modes.example: The increased risk of asthma-related death is considered a class effect<< of>> LABA monotherapy.

card.plain: It fires on small linking marks, like a colon or "of", that come just before a named drug class or section title in warnings.
